I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM:

- **#PD-4492**: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth", dated 5 Oct 2025. Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct because the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk wasn't sending SMS bay assignments for Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it that day, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed. The note also says the kiosk logs need archiving before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
- **#4419**: from "Moss: North cheat sheet", which has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. Since the note is undated, I can't tell whether that status is still current.

I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared files, and they're all public. Moss's other two QFL notes, the 9/14 pipeline digest and the 3/23 renewal check-in, don't give any ticket numbers. His two Central team notes don't mention QFL.

I left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways". It's a different company that isn't our customer, and it isn't one of Moss's notes.
